definitions.explanation: Having an extremely sharp or refined ability to perceive, detect, or respond. Used for senses, intuition, or mental acuity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鋭敏|えいびん}な⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: She has a keen sense of perception.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧はるか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鋭敏|えいびん}な⟦{嗅覚|きゅうかく}→嗅覚：04422_kyuukaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Dogs have a far more acute sense of smell than humans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鋭敏|えいびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}できる→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|い}き{残|のこ}る→生き残る：13521_ikinokoru⟧。
examples.english: Only companies that can respond keenly to changes in the times will survive.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes heightened sensitivity or sharpness of perception, whether physical senses or mental awareness. More formal and literary than ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ (sharp).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鋭敏|えいびん}: keen, acute (formal, emphasizes refined sensitivity)
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: sharp (general, everyday usage)
- ⟦{敏感|びんかん}→敏感：06641_binkan⟧: sensitive (reactive to stimuli, sometimes overly so)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鋭敏|えいびん}な⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧ (keen sense)
- {鋭敏|えいびん}な⟦{嗅覚|きゅうかく}→嗅覚：04422_kyuukaku⟧ (acute sense of smell)
- {鋭敏|えいびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}する→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧ (to react keenly)
